items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What kind of stuff did Buddy Bowden play? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh this old old iron blues stuff like that.

ctx.x: He played like you say marches and what's his man named that died, this great band leader, what's his name name? Susan? Susan's band played stuff like that you know.
What kind of stuff did Buddy Bowden play?
Oh this old old iron blues stuff like that. You remember any of them? Well you see the old old iron blues he played. On the piano I did but not on this guitar. On the piano I know some.
